# sendgrid_template (Resource)

Manages a SendGrid dynamic template.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the template.

### Optional

- `generation` (String) The generation of the template. Must be `dynamic`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The template ID (e.g. `d-xxxx`).
- `updated_at` (String) The last time the template was updated.
